title: Baked Feta Pasta
instructions: In a 13 x 9 in. baking dish, combine 2 pints cherry tomatoes, 3 halved garlic cloves and ¼ cup olive oil.
Place 8 oz feta in center, moving tomatoes so cheese sits on pan bottom.
Drizzle feta with another ¼ cup olive oil; sprinkle with 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper (we also put red pepper flakes, basil, oregano, etc).
Bake until tomatoes split and garlic softens, 30-40 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook 16 oz. rigatoni or other short pasta according to package directions for al dente.
Drain, reserving 1 cup pasta water. Stir feta mixture, lightly pressing tomatoes, until combined. Add pasta; toss to combine. Stir in enough reserved pasta water to achieve desired consistency.
